_readme: PREVIEW ONLY. Invented sample values to review the layout with content in place. Merged over site.json/finance.json in the 'sample' preview view; the build refuses to use it for a launch build. Currency code SMP is deliberately not a real currency.

site.headline: Help complete a masjid for our community
site.lede: The walls are up. Your support now goes toward the roof, so the building can be enclosed before winter. (Sample text.)

organisation.name: Sample Masjid Trust
organisation.relationshipToMasjid: The Trust owns the land and is the legal body building and running the masjid. (Sample.)

campaign.figureSource: Manually reconciled from the payment provider dashboard and the Trust's bank statement.
campaign.allocationNote: Donations go into one general construction fund and are applied to the current priority first. (Sample wording.)

paragraphs: Sample paragraph: who the masjid will serve, such as families in the area who currently travel a long way to pray in congregation.
Sample paragraph: why a purpose-built space is needed, and what it will be used for: daily prayers, Jumu'ah, classes for children.
Sample paragraph: who is responsible. The project is run by volunteers on behalf of the Trust, with a qualified contractor and site engineer.

policies.refund: If you made a mistake, contact us within 30 days and we will work with the payment provider to refund it where possible. (Sample policy.)
policies.surplusAndDelays: If the roof phase is over-funded or delayed, donations go to the next construction priority listed on this page. (Sample policy.)
policies.fees: The payment provider deducts a processing fee from each donation. (Sample: state the real fee basis once confirmed.)

recurring.cancellation: Cancel any time from the link in your confirmation email, or contact us.
